evidence: If such utilization by CNA's industry peers is more effective than how it uses its data and information, including through its own use of AI, CNA will be at a competitive disadvantage.

When new technologies, such as AI, are incorporated into CNA's or its third-party service providers processes, they may introduce additional complexity and present greater risk to the effectiveness of these controls.

generative AI systems may hallucinate producing inaccurate or misleading information, and model performance may degrade over time, leading to flawed recommendations. AI models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in underlying data, which could result in discriminatory or unfair outcomes in areas such as underwriting and claims.

the increasing use of artificial intelligence and other advances in computer capabilities and technologies, by us and our subsidiaries and by our and their vendors and other third parties with whom we and they do business, may increase our and their exposure to risks of cyber attacks and other cyber incidents.
ai_positioning.summary: L adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques concurrentiels, les défaillances technologiques (hallucinations, dégradation des modèles), les biais discriminatoires et les menaces cybersécuritaires. L'entreprise reconnaît utiliser l'IA mais craint de ne pas être aussi efficace que ses concurrents.

overrides_hero_kpi.label: CNA_REV_PCT
overrides_hero_kpi.rationale_segment_specific: The metric 'CNA_REV_PCT' is derived as the percentage of CNA's total revenue relative to Loews Corporation's consolidated total revenue. Values are calculated from 'Total' revenue lines under 'CNA Financial' and 'Total' columns in the 'Statements of Operations by segment' tables in both filings. All values are explicitly reported in millions and allow exact computation of percentages. The latest filing (FY2024) provides 2021-2023 data, and the older filing (FY2021) provides 2018-2020 data. The percentages were computed directly from disclosed revenue totals, ensuring literal sourcing.
